name: pip_physics_soft_swa_l60_ctrl
note: PIP/MobilePoser physics optimizer with softer angular PD gains (kp 600 / kd 30 instead of PIP's defaults; 50 Hz, 2x upsampled, soft foot contacts, 0 QP failures over 207k frames, 50 min CPU): SIP 15.85 -> 15.96, mesh 8.94 -> 9.04, MPJVE 23.6 -> 23.2, jitter 148 -> 107. The dynamics smooth the motion but do not improve pose: with PIP's gains the optimizer tracks the network (no change), with softer gains it lags it. MobilePoser's gain from this stage comes with its own velocity/contact heads and a translation estimate; our pose-only model has nothing for the simulator to correct toward. Post-processing thread closed: no variant improved SIP or mesh error.
